title: Dubai: Luxury City & Desert Escape
summary: A short, dense trip built to contrast — rooftop dinners above the skyline, a private desert safari at golden hour, and a souk crawl for anyone who wants to haggle.
highlights: A private desert safari at golden hour
Dinner at a rooftop table over the skyline
A dhow cruise along Dubai Creek

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai
itinerary.description: Settle into a skyline-view hotel, dinner at a rooftop table.

itinerary.title: Old Dubai
itinerary.description: The Gold and Spice Souks, then a dhow cruise along the Creek.

itinerary.title: Desert safari
itinerary.description: A private 4x4 desert safari timed for golden hour, dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: City day
itinerary.description: Free time to explore, with a recommended itinerary from your travel consultant.

itinerary.title: Depart Dubai
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.
